text:
QUOTE: "**Schema, index older than server:** call `index(action='refresh', force=True)`. - **Schema, index newer than server, or code stale:** restart the MCP client. A rebuild cannot clear these, because it re-stamps the same newer version or the running process still holds old logic."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says rebuild clears data and restart clears code, but it never says this is why one flag would not have been enough.
